prompt: In a photorealistic photo, the scene unfolds within a sunlit pottery workshop filled with creative energy. On the left side of the frame, an elderly woman with silver hair sits on a wooden stool, her hands covered in wet gray clay as she shapes a bowl on a spinning wheel. Next to her stands a young man in a blue apron, who is pointing at the rim of the wet clay vessel to offer guidance. A small tabby cat sleeps peacefully on a shelf above them, its tail curled around its body. In the center of the room, a large oak table holds twelve distinct ceramic pieces in various stages of drying. A tall vase with blue glaze sits prominently on the table, while a cracked mug lies beside it. A child in a yellow shirt reaches out to touch the smooth surface of a finished plate, their fingers hovering just millimeters above the ceramic. Standing behind the child is a teacher with glasses, who is looking at the student's hand with a gentle expression. To the right, a potter in a green smock is handing a sponge to an apprentice in a white t-shirt, who accepts it with both hands. Near the window on the right wall, a potted fern adds a touch of nature to the industrial space. A brown dog lies on the floor near the door, chewing on a rubber toy. An easel in the corner displays a sketch of a teapot, drawn in charcoal. A bucket of murky water sits on the floor next to the easel, reflecting the light from the window. A stack of newspapers rests on a nearby chair, used for cleaning up spills. A metal rack holds several baking trays, some empty and some holding raw clay forms. A clock on the wall shows the time as mid-afternoon. A broom leans against the back wall, its bristles worn from use. There is no digital screen visible in the workshop. There is no plastic packaging anywhere in the scene. There is no modern electronic device present.
